title: Constant array with named-association aggregate + user-defined function elements + others fallback
sourceUrl: internal: Kmila constant-array named-aggregate regression (handoff §5 P2A shape)
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: ROM initialized with named-association aggregate `(0 => pack(3), 1 => pack(5), ..., others => (others => '0'))` where `pack` is a user-defined function defined in the architecture declarative part. Indexed read each cycle. Mirrors P2A's rom_init shape. Tests: (a) named-association aggregate parsing, (b) user-defined function evaluation at constant-init time, (c) `others =>` fallback fill for unspecified slots, (d) cooperates with the positional-aggregate path shipped in 122/123.
